title: Align Lib Rs To Target Schema (Partial)
description: Complete align_lib.rs_to_target_schema plan: interfaces, entities, vcs (Draft→Alternative), diffs, modifications, inputs, operations, entrypoints, tests. Single file compose/rs/lib.rs only.
summary: Partial alignment to target.schema.graphql in compose/rs/lib.rs only: added gql_relay EditConnection + OperationConnection and OperationIface::row_id; folded Draft out of GraphQL (removed Draft #[Object], Session.drafts, Graph draft/drafts, Kit draft/transaction, Alternative draft/transaction); Change.owner now ChangeOwner union Alternative|Checkpoint with ChangeOwnerRef wiring in record_op; Change gains edits EditConnection + SDL-ish metadata fields and parent_edit link; Edit gains forwards/backwards OperationConnection (fed from worker), sequence/timestamps/description/origin, owner EditOwner Alternative|Checkpoint; WriteVersion exposes draftId instead of Draft object; worker links RenameKit/CreatedFixedPiece to active Edit (owner_edit + forward_iface_ops). Removed Operation.changeOwner from interface impls. Validation: cargo test -p compose --lib (36 passed) and bun scripts/export-schema.ts OK. Blockers for remaining plan items: full Entity/StrongEntity/Artifact interface ladder on Kit/Graph/Session and ~85 Operation types + Diff/Modification/Modifications families still missing or stubbed; Operation.scope/input/modification not wired; EntityIface recursive owner; many Edge/Connection registrations.
